IH.Core.mod.Name: Informative Healthbar
IH.Core.theme.Name: Color Theme
IH.Core.theme.Desc: Select a color theme: Full Colored, Icon Colored, Classic Blue, Classic Yellow, Classic Red
IH.Core.position.Name: Position
IH.Core.position.Desc: Below Healthbar avoids overlap but pushes down Staminabar. Above sits on top.
IH.Core.offsetX.Name: Offset X
IH.Core.offsetX.Desc: Correct the Offset in X direction (left right). To align with the Level frame, set to -66.0
IH.Core.offsetY.Name: Offset Y
IH.Core.offsetY.Desc: Correct the Offset in Y direction (top bottom).
IH.Core.childMargin.Name: Widget Spacing
IH.Core.childMargin.Desc: Adjust the horizontal distance between each stat.
IH.Core.panelScale.Name: Panel Scale
IH.Core.panelScale.Desc: Scale the entire panel up or down (1.0 is default size).
IH.Core.hideLevelBadge.Name: Hide Vanilla Level Badge
IH.Core.hideLevelBadge.Desc: Hides the large character level badge attached left to the healthbar. Use with Optional Level widget. (IGNORED IF E3 HUD IS ACTIVE)
IH.Core.hideBars.Name: Hide Vanilla Bars
IH.Core.hideBars.Desc: Hides the vanilla health, RAM, and exp bars. (IGNORED IF E3 HUD IS ACTIVE)
IH.Core.hideCounters.Name: Hide Vanilla Counters
IH.Core.hideCounters.Desc: Hides the numerical health and ram counters. (IGNORED IF E3 HUD IS ACTIVE)
IH.Core.hideBuffs.Name: Hide Vanilla Buffs
IH.Core.hideBuffs.Desc: Hides the status effect icons (buffs and debuffs) that appear next to the healthbar. (IGNORED IF E3 HUD IS ACTIVE)
IH.Core.ramFix.Name: Enable RAM Bar Fix
IH.Core.ramFix.Desc: Shrinks the cyberdeck RAM bar when you have lots of slots, adds a fill/max counter readout, and stops big RAM bars from pushing the healthbar around. (Note: Automatically disabled if E3 HUD is detected to prevent conflicts!)
IH.Core.alwaysShowBars.Name: Always Show Healthbar
IH.Core.alwaysShowBars.Desc: Prevents the healthbar from auto-hiding when you are out of combat and at full health.
IH.Core.showRamText.Name: Show RAM Counter Text
IH.Core.showRamText.Desc: Displays the numerical RAM fill/max counter on the healthbar.
IH.Core.ramHOffset.Name: RAM Counter - Horizontal Offset
IH.Core.ramVOffset.Name: RAM Counter - Vertical Offset
IH.Core.ramFontSize.Name: RAM Counter - Font Size
IH.Core.ramFontSize.Desc: Font size of the RAM counter text. Default 32.
IH.Core.debuffStyle.Name: Debuff Color Style
IH.Core.debuffStyle.Desc: Choose how debuffs are colored. Vanilla = All Blue, Icons Only = Red Icons, Full = Entire debuff widget is Red.
IH.Core.debuffCounterPos.Name: Counter Position
IH.Core.debuffCounterPos.Desc: Choose whether the duration counter sits above or below the status effect icon.
IH.Core.widgetSorting.Name: Enable Custom Widget Sorting
IH.Core.widgetSorting.Desc: Enables manually rearranging the left-to-right order of your stats panel widgets.
IH.CoreStats.showLifepath.Name: Show Lifepath
IH.CoreStats.showLifepath.Desc: Show Icon and Lifepath name, compatible with The Fresh Start. (IGNORED IF SHOW LEVEL IS ENABLED)
IH.CoreStats.showLevel.Name: Show Level (Replaces Lifepath)
IH.CoreStats.showLevel.Desc: Overwrites the Lifepath text with your Character Level.
IH.CoreStats.showStreetCred.Name: Show Street Cred
IH.CoreStats.showMoney.Name: Show Money
IH.CoreStats.showMoney.Desc: Use Numerals Get Commas mod to format display.
IH.CoreStats.showCarryWeight.Name: Show Carry Weight
IH.CoreStats.showCarryWeight.Desc: Compatible with Flesh And Chrome - Carry Overhaul.
IH.CoreStats.weightDisplay.Name: Carry Weight Format
IH.CoreStats.weightDisplay.Desc: Choose between absolute values (Current/Max) or a Percentage (%).
IH.CoreStats.showArmor.Name: Show Armor
IH.CoreStats.showArmor.Desc: Shows your current armor value. Turns to Armor Integrity % when Chrome Plating is used.
IH.CoreStats.lifepathOrder.Name: Order: Lifepath / Level
IH.CoreStats.streetCredOrder.Name: Order: Street Cred
IH.CoreStats.moneyOrder.Name: Order: Money
IH.CoreStats.weightOrder.Name: Order: Carry Weight
IH.CoreStats.armorOrder.Name: Order: Armor
IH.Clock.showClock.Name: Show Game Clock
IH.Clock.showClock.Desc: Shows the current in-game time in Night City. Perfect for no-Minimap setups!
IH.Clock.clockOrder.Name: Order: Game Clock
IH.Clock.clockFormat.Name: Game Clock: Use AM/PM
IH.Health.showTracker.Name: Show Health Tracker
IH.Health.showTracker.Desc: Displays your Health as a precise numerical value or percentage.
IH.Health.healthDisplay.Name: Health Format
IH.Health.healthDisplay.Desc: Choose between absolute values (Current/Max) or a Percentage (%).
IH.Health.healthTrackerOrder.Name: Order: Health Tracker
IH.Kills.showTracker.Name: Show Kills Tracker
IH.Kills.showTracker.Desc: Displays your total lifetime kills (Kills + Takedowns).
IH.Kills.killsTrackerOrder.Name: Order: Kills Tracker
IH.Kills.useStealthrunner.Name: Use Stealthrunner Stats
IH.Kills.useStealthrunner.Desc: Replaces the vanilla kill counter with Stealthrunner's kills tracking.
IH.Camo.showCamo.Name: Show Optical Camo
IH.Camo.showCamo.Desc: Displays active charge/cooldown for Optical Camo. Auto-hides when at 100%.
IH.Camo.camoOrder.Name: Order: Optical Camo
IH.OS.showCooldown.Name: Show OS Cooldown
IH.OS.showCooldown.Desc: Displays active charge/cooldown for Sandevistan and Berserk. Auto-hides when fully ready.
IH.OS.osCooldownOrder.Name: Order: OS Cooldown
IH.Pacifist.showTracker.Name: Show Pacifist Tracker
IH.Pacifist.showTracker.Desc: Displays your total non-lethal takedowns (unconscious enemies).
IH.Pacifist.pacifistTrackerOrder.Name: Order: Pacifist Tracker
IH.Pacifist.useStealthrunner.Name: Use Stealthrunner Stats
IH.Pacifist.useStealthrunner.Desc: Replaces the vanilla takedown counter with Stealthrunner's non-lethal tracking.
IH.RAM.showTracker.Name: Show RAM Tracker
IH.RAM.showTracker.Desc: Displays your Cyberdeck RAM as a text counter. Auto-hides if no Cyberdeck is equipped.
IH.RAM.ramTrackerOrder.Name: Order: RAM Tracker
IH.Stamina.showStamina.Name: Show Stamina
IH.Stamina.showStamina.Desc: Shows your stamina percentage dynamically. Compatible with Flesh & Chrome
IH.Stamina.staminaOrder.Name: Order: Stamina
IH.Stamina.useFACColors.Name: Stamina Colors of Flesh & Chrome
IH.Stamina.useFACColors.Desc: Enables Flesh & Chrome based dynamic coloring for the Stamina widget.
IH.Energy.showEnergy.Name: Flesh & Chrome: Show Energy
IH.Energy.showEnergy.Desc: Displays your current Energy level from the Flesh & Chrome mod.
IH.Energy.energyOrder.Name: Order: Energy (Flesh & Chrome)
IH.Wanted.showWanted.Name: Show Wanted Level
IH.Wanted.hideWantedZero.Name: Hide Wanted if Clear
IH.Wanted.hideWantedZero.Desc: If enabled, the tracker disappears completely when you have no bounty. If disabled, it stays visible as CLEAR.
IH.Wanted.showSubMetrics.Name: Show Wanted Sub-Metrics
IH.Wanted.showSubMetrics.Desc: Displays detailed NCPD pursuit information such as Heat Progress, Evading Timers, and Clearing Timers.
IH.Wanted.wantedOrder.Name: Order: Wanted Level
IH.DrugDealer.showRank.Name: Drug Dealer: Show Rank
IH.DrugDealer.showRank.Desc: Displays your current criminal empire rank on the HUD.
IH.DrugDealer.showTerror.Name: Drug Dealer: Show Terror
IH.DrugDealer.showTerror.Desc: Displays your turf terror level as a percentage. Only visible when active.
IH.DrugDealer.ddRankOrder.Name: Order: Drug Dealer Rank
IH.DrugDealer.ddTerrorOrder.Name: Order: Drug Dealer Terror
IH.EWH.showWidget.Name: EWH: Show Weapon Exposure
IH.EWH.showWidget.Desc: Shows the Environmental Weapon Handling exposure percentage.
IH.EWH.ewhOrder.Name: Order: Weapon Exposure (EWH)
IH.SynthDose.replaceBar.Name: SynthDose: Toxicity
IH.SynthDose.HideZeroDesc: If enabled, the tracker disappears completely when you have 0% toxicity. If disabled, it stays visible.
IH.SynthDose.toxicityOrder.Name: Order: Toxicity (SynthDose)
IH.WE.replaceBar.Name: Wannabe Edgerunner: Replace Bar
IH.WE.replaceBar.Desc: Hides the Humanity bar and uses a clean widget instead.
IH.WE.humanityOrder.Name: Order: Humanity (WE)
IH.ChromePlating.showWornArmor.Name: Chrome Plating: Worn Armor
IH.ChromePlating.showWornArmor.Desc: Show Chrome Plating's Worn Armor % here. When on, CP's own HUD widget hides itself so we don't double up.
IH.ChromePlating.hideWornArmorZero.Name: Hide Worn Armor if 0%
IH.ChromePlating.hideWornArmorZero.Desc: If enabled, the Worn Armor stat will disappear completely when it hits 0%. If disabled, it stays visible and turns red.
IH.ChromePlating.wornArmorOrder.Name: Order: Worn Armor
IH.Oxygen.showOxygen.Name: Show Oxygen
IH.Oxygen.showOxygen.Desc: Shows your oxygen percentage dynamically when swimming.
IH.Oxygen.oxygenOrder.Name: Order: Oxygen
IH.FPS.showFPS.Name: Show FPS
IH.FPS.showFPS.Desc: Displays a real-time Frames Per Second counter.
IH.FPS.fpsMode.Name: FPS Display Mode
IH.FPS.fpsMode.Desc: Standard: 0.5s Average. Frame Time: Adds ms delay. Stutter Tracker: Shows 1% Lows/Minimums.
IH.FPS.UseFrameGen.Name: Frame Generation
IH.FPS.UseFrameGen.Desc: Includes generated DLSS/FSR frames in the FPS calculation. If disabled, only the true, engine-rendered frames (raw FPS) are measured. Requires the game to broadcast this telemetry.
IH.FPS.fpsOrder.Name: Order: FPS Tracker
IH.FNCB.showWidget.Name: 1st NC Bank: Show Tracker
IH.FNCB.showWidget.Desc: Displays your 1st Night City Bank balance and active loan debt.
IH.FNCB.displayMode.Name: 1st NC Bank: Display Mode
IH.FNCB.displayMode.Desc: Bank & Debt: Shows balance & loan. Debt Only: Hides if debt-free. Net Worth: Wallet+Bank-Debt. Daily Due: Shows today's payment.
IH.FNCB.fncbOrder.Name: Order: 1st NC Bank Tracker
IH.MARMUR.showWidget.Name: Marmur Bank: Show Tracker
IH.MARMUR.showWidget.Desc: Displays your bank balance, debt, or net worth on the HUD.
IH.MARMUR.displayMode.Name: Display Mode
IH.MARMUR.displayMode.Desc: Choose what data the tracker should show.
IH.MARMUR.order.Name: Order: Marmur Bank Tracker
IH.NCB.showWidget.Name: Night City Bank: Show Tracker
IH.NCB.showWidget.Desc: Displays your bank balance, yield, and financial progress on the HUD.
IH.NCB.displayMode.Name: Display Mode
IH.NCB.displayMode.Desc: Choose which financial metrics to display alongside your balance.
IH.NCB.order.Name: Order: Night City Bank Tracker
IH.Courier.showTimer.Name: Show Courier Timer
IH.Courier.showTimer.Desc: Displays the countdown timer during vehicle delivery missions. Perfect for no-minimap setups.
IH.Courier.timerOrder.Name: Order: Courier Timer
IH.FAP.showWidget.Name: FAP: Show Integrity
IH.FAP.showWidget.Desc: Displays your personal link integrity from the Filthy Access Points mod.
IH.FAP.hideFull.Name: Hide Integrity if 100%
IH.FAP.hideFull.Desc: If enabled, the integrity stat will disappear completely when it is at 100%.
IH.FAP.fapOrder.Name: Order: Integrity (FAP)
IH.Calendar.showWidget.Name: Calendar: Show Date
IH.Calendar.showWidget.Desc: Displays the current in-game date. Requires the 'Calendar' mod.
IH.Calendar.format.Name: Date Format
IH.Calendar.format.Desc: Choose how the date is displayed.
IH.Calendar.calendarOrder.Name: Order: Calendar
IH.FE.showBowel.Name: Flushing Etiquette: Show Bowel Pressure
IH.FE.showBowel.Desc: Displays your bowel pressure as a compact percentage widget.
IH.FE.hideBowelSafe.Name: Hide Bowel when Safe
IH.FE.hideBowelSafe.Desc: If enabled, the widget hides completely when pressure is below the mod's warning threshold.
IH.FE.showHygiene.Name: Flushing Etiquette: Show Hygiene
IH.FE.showHygiene.Desc: Displays your hygiene level as a compact percentage widget.
IH.FE.hideHygieneSafe.Name: Hide Hygiene when Clean
IH.FE.hideHygieneSafe.Desc: If enabled, the widget hides completely when hygiene is above the mod's warning threshold.
IH.FE.bowelOrder.Name: Order: Bowel Pressure (FE)
IH.FE.hygieneOrder.Name: Order: Hygiene (FE)
IH.ArmorUp.showShield.Name: Armor Up: Show Shield Points
IH.ArmorUp.showShield.Desc: Displays your active shield points as a compact percentage widget and suppresses the mod's native healthbar UI.
IH.ArmorUp.showUI.Name: Armor Up: Show Native UI
IH.ArmorUp.showUI.Desc: Show the native shield bar and overshield text injected by the Armor Up mod into your healthbar.
IH.ArmorUp.shieldOrder.Name: Order: Shield Points (Armor Up)
IH.TNV.showBattery.Name: True Night Vision: Show Battery
IH.TNV.showBattery.Desc: Displays your NVG battery charge as a compact percentage widget.
IH.TNV.hideNativeBar.Name: Hide Native Battery Bar
IH.TNV.hideNativeBar.Desc: Suppresses the mod's original battery bar UI to prevent overlapping.
IH.TNV.batteryOrder.Name: Order: Battery (TNV)
IH.TF.showBattery.Name: True Flashlight: Show Battery
IH.TF.showBattery.Desc: Displays your flashlight battery charge as a compact percentage widget.
IH.TF.hideFull.Name: Hide when Fully Charged
IH.TF.hideFull.Desc: If enabled, the widget hides completely when your flashlight battery is at 100%.
IH.TF.batteryOrder.Name: Order: Battery (TF)
IH.DF.showHydration.Name: Dark Future: Show Hydration
IH.DF.showHydration.Desc: Displays your hydration level as a compact percentage widget. Automatically hides based on Dark Future's visibility threshold.
IH.DF.showNutrition.Name: Dark Future: Show Nutrition
IH.DF.showNutrition.Desc: Displays your nutrition level as a compact percentage widget. Automatically hides based on Dark Future's visibility threshold.
IH.DF.showEnergy.Name: Dark Future: Show Energy
IH.DF.showEnergy.Desc: Displays your energy level as a compact percentage widget. Automatically hides based on Dark Future's visibility threshold.
IH.DF.showNerve.Name: Dark Future: Show Nerve
IH.DF.showNerve.Desc: Displays your nerve level as a compact percentage widget. Automatically hides based on Dark Future's visibility threshold.
IH.DF.hydrationOrder.Name: Order: Hydration (Dark Future)
IH.DF.nutritionOrder.Name: Order: Nutrition (Dark Future)
IH.DF.energyOrder.Name: Order: Energy (Dark Future)
IH.DF.nerveOrder.Name: Order: Nerve (Dark Future)
IH.SC.showIntegrity.Name: Shattered Chrome: Show Integrity
IH.SC.showIntegrity.Desc: Displays average cyberware integrity and the number of broken implants.
IH.SC.hideFull.Name: Hide Integrity if 100%
IH.SC.hideFull.Desc: If enabled, the integrity stat will disappear completely when it is at 100%.
IH.SC.scOrder.Name: Order: Integrity (Shattered Chrome)
IH.CNS.showWidget.Name: Conscience: Show Tracker
IH.CNS.showWidget.Desc: Displays your current Guilt level as a compact percentage widget. (Note: Turn off the native mod HUD in the Conscience Mod Settings).
IH.CNS.displayMode.Name: Conscience: Visibility Threshold
IH.CNS.displayMode.Desc: Choose at which escalation tier the widget should appear.
IH.CNS.order.Name: Order: Conscience (Guilt)
